_meta.join_key: Sage customer number (the id here) is expected to survive migration as the NetSuite customer entityid prefix (e.g. '0000004 Artistic Concrete'). The join is done in NetSuite by src/data/queries/vintage_accounts.sql; see src/data/vintage.py.
_meta.scope: The whole Sage company, GarageExperts franchise accounts included (ids starting GE), so report totals are not subsidiary-2 marketing revenue and must not be compared with NetSuite figures without the category exclusions applied at join time.
_meta.source: Sage 100 report AR_CustomerSlsHistByPer (Customer Sales History by Period), three workbooks supplied by Jules 2026-09-05: 2019-2020, 2021-2022, 2023-Sep 2024. Sage was replaced by NetSuite in Q4 2024.
_meta.what_it_is: Per Sage customer, annual net dollars sold for each calendar year 2019-2024 (2024 = January-September only), as the report's 'Total YYYY' column. Negative totals were printed by Sage with a trailing minus ('1,302.00-') and are parsed as negatives.
_meta.what_it_is_not: Not a created-date export. The earliest year covered is 2019, so an account with sales in 2019 is 'acquired 2019 or earlier' (first_sale_year_is_floor = true); the pre-2018 band v1 published cannot be recovered from these files.
